messages:
lina: Quick heads-up: sampleapp onboarding fail — SDK picked env project over key-bound project.

samir: Which env var?

lina: REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT=redwood-prod while REDWOOD_API_KEY is org-scoped (acme). App used redwood-prod.

maria: Intended precedence: explicit param > key-bound project > REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT > prompt. CLI currently disagrees.

ajay: Root cause: introspect fallback ordering in node sdk. Current code evaluates env var before awaiting introspect.

lina: Patch idea: await introspect first, then fallback to env var. Add warning telemetry when fallback happens.

samir: Also add AuthScopeMismatch soft error for rotation cases so we fail-fast instead of silently switching projects.

maria: Add README note for sampleapp and update CLI parity in next sprint.

devx-bot: PR #4587 opened by lina - "fix(auth): prefer key-bound project over REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT". CI queued.
